answer: Zero-knowledge proof of post-epoch generation at the dune: each identity must submit a zk proof it was forged after the prior epoch's final block, binding a fresh nullifier. Cloning is a fable—replaying old proofs fails, since the echo of spent nullifiers is public. Minting 1,000 sybils costs 1,000 fresh proofs × 40 CPU-hours plus $18 bond each ≈ $18k, while payouts stay linear. The mechanism works because identity creation is priced in verifiable post-epoch work, not registration.
